findings.sample: /usr/bin/sample exists, is universal, defaults to 1 ms, and advertises -wait, -mayDie, -fullPaths, and -file textual call-tree output
findings.xctrace: xctrace 26.0 (17C529) advertises record/export/symbolicate, Time Profiler and Sampler, --launch, --no-prompt, --output, --target-stdout, and --target-stderr
findings.permissions: the SSH user is in admin and _developer and Developer Mode is enabled; task-port and Instruments authorization rights require authenticate-user, so noninteractive profiling permission was not assumed
findings.symbolization: the frozen path requires one optimized Mach-O, a matching dSYM UUID, stable noinline symbols, TOC discovery, and XML export; none was sampled in Phase 1
